items.title: Sony Music, Warner Sue Anthropic Over Alleged IP Theft
items.summary: Sony Music and Warner Music have filed a lawsuit against AI firm Anthropic, accusing them of a 'brazen campaign' of intellectual property theft, marking a significant legal challenge in the AI industry.

items.title: Nvidia's AI Advantage Extends Beyond GPUs to Full-Stack Solutions
items.summary: Nvidia's strategic focus is shifting beyond just hardware, as its AI advantage now encompasses a broader ecosystem of software and services, solidifying its position in the evolving AI landscape.

items.title: Training Agents to Evolve with Their Harness: TaoLive Digital Avatar Agent Technical Report
items.summary: A new technical report details TaoLive's approach to training digital avatar agents that can dynamically evolve alongside their operational environments, showcasing advancements in adaptive AI.

items.title: Railway Secures $100 Million to Compete with AWS in AI-Native Cloud Infrastructure
items.summary: Railway has raised $100 million in funding to develop an AI-native cloud infrastructure, aiming to directly challenge established giants like AWS in the rapidly growing market.

items.title: Google Redesigns Search Box for First Time in 25 Years, Signaling Deeper AI Integration
items.summary: Google has unveiled the first redesign of its iconic search box in 25 years, a move that hints at deeper AI integration and a significant shift in how users will interact with search.

items.title: Is Next-Chunk Reasoning RL Really Better than SFT? Revisiting Training Strategies under no-CoT Data
items.summary: Researchers investigate whether Reinforcement Learning with next-chunk reasoning truly outperforms Supervised Fine-Tuning when training language models without Chain-of-Thought data, re-evaluating core LLM training strategies.

items.title: Long-Horizon Audio-Visual Generation for Persistent Stories and Interactive Worlds
items.summary: New research explores techniques for generating extended, consistent audio-visual content, paving the way for more immersive and interactive digital stories and virtual worlds.

items.title: Open-MOPD: Diagnosing and Fixing Capability Imbalance in Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
items.summary: A new paper introduces Open-MOPD, a method for diagnosing and resolving capability imbalances in multi-teacher on-policy distillation, improving the effectiveness of complex reinforcement learning systems.

items.title: StreamPI: Streaming Multimodal Temporal Modeling for Vision-Language-Action Models
items.summary: StreamPI presents a novel approach to streaming multimodal temporal modeling, enhancing the capabilities of Vision-Language-Action models for real-time understanding and interaction.

items.title: Zero-WAM: In-Context World-Action Modeling from Human Videos for Open-Ended Task Generalization
items.summary: Zero-WAM introduces a method for in-context world-action modeling derived from human videos, enabling AI agents to achieve better generalization across open-ended tasks.

items.title: Understanding Evolution Strategies for LLM Reasoning: Broader Reasoning Coverage than GRPO
items.summary: This research delves into evolution strategies for Large Language Model reasoning, demonstrating that they can achieve broader reasoning coverage compared to traditional GRPO methods.

items.title: Video-IFBench: Evaluating Instruction Following of Multimodal LLMs in Video Understanding Scenarios
items.summary: Video-IFBench introduces a new benchmark for rigorously evaluating how well multimodal Large Language Models follow instructions in complex video understanding scenarios.

items.title: V-Rubrics: Visual Faithfulness via Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning
items.summary: V-Rubrics proposes a novel method for achieving visual faithfulness in AI-generated content by employing rubric-based reinforcement learning.

items.title: SWE Refactor Bench: Can Coding Agents Complete a Long-Horizon, Whole-Repository Stack Migration?
items.summary: SWE Refactor Bench evaluates the capability of coding agents to perform complex, long-horizon tasks such as migrating an entire repository's technology stack, pushing the boundaries of autonomous software engineering.

items.title: I Thought My Multi-Agent Debate Engine Was Broken. The Real Bug Was the Prompt.
items.summary: A developer shares insights into debugging a multi-agent debate engine, discovering that the core issue wasn't a code bug but a flawed prompt design, highlighting the criticality of prompt engineering.
